message.content:
{
  "criterion_comparisons": [
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C2",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C2",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "TCO is a firm earnings commitment, while productivity hours may not fully convert into financial benefits."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C3",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Production effort directly affects implementation cost, timing, and execution risk; excess throughput has less immediate financial relevance."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Compliance losses are monetized downside with governance consequences, while released hours remain vulnerable to weak benefits realization."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "very_strong",
      "reason": "Recurring ownership cost has a larger, more visible margin impact than a bounded proficiency investment."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C4_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C4",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "very_strong",
      "reason": "Avoiding exposure and compliance losses outweighs higher request capacity once target service requirements are met."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C3",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C3",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Recurring productivity potential supports the multi-year business case, though integration effort remains important to initial cash requirements."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "TCO is a certain annual burden across the evaluation horizon, whereas compliance loss is probability weighted."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C5_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C5",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C6",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Faster proficiency improves adoption and benefit timing across the workforce; additional throughput matters only when demand approaches capacity."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Annual compliance exposure creates continuing financial and oversight risk, while integration effort is primarily a one-time commitment."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Annual released capacity is the central economic benefit; onboarding time mainly influences how quickly that benefit begins."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "very_strong",
      "reason": "Recurring cost directly affects budgets and margins, while throughput is a technical benefit without explicit financial conversion."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C4_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C4",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "very_strong",
      "reason": "Data and compliance failures can create material losses and control issues beyond the temporary cost of user training."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Productivity hours connect more directly to business-case value than platform request capacity."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C3",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C3",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Annualized TCO drives recurring budget and margin impact, while integration effort is concentrated before production."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C3",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Production readiness effort determines upfront funding, delivery timing, and implementation risk more directly than individual learning time."
    }
  ],
  "declared_priority_order": [
    "C1",
    "C4",
    "C2"
  ]
}
